subject: Manifest secrets rotation & marketplace deploy timing
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@cloudpartner.co>, Joel Tan <joel@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Manifest secrets rotation & marketplace deploy timing

Hi Samir / Joel,

Thanks for the earlier check-in. We have two items we need to align on before we can finalize the Azure Marketplace push for Acme Cloud Partners:

1) Manifest/service-principal secrets rotation — we're planning a controlled rotation of the publishing service principal (key rotation + manifest update) and would like to coordinate the exact cutover window so it doesn't conflict with your listing tasks.
2) Listing deployment window — we'd like to reserve a deploy slot in the week of June 24 if that's still available.

I've attached a small diff of the manifest (manifest.json.diff) and a proposed deploy timeline (deploy_timeline.xlsx). High-level asks: can Microsoft accept a short maintenance window for the SP secret swap, and do you need any additional evidence (publisher ID, notarized contact) to proceed with the listing window?

Proposed plan: rotate SP keys early morning (US-PST), update manifest, then push listing assets + final validation in the same maintenance window. Target target window: June 24, 03:00-06:00 UTC.

Please confirm: (a) Acceptable to rotate existing SP vs create a new SP? (b) Any blackout windows on your side? (c) Do you need a DocuSign amendment for the publisher record?

Thanks — I'll consolidate answers and loop legal if needed.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: manifest.json.diff (text), deploy_timeline.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Samir Patel <samir@cloudpartner.co>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Joel Tan <joel@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-16T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Manifest secrets rotation & marketplace deploy timing

Kimberly — thanks for the heads-up. A couple quick clarifications: 

On Wed, Jun 16, 2026 at 09:12 AM, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks for the earlier check-in. We have two items we need to align on before we can finalize the Azure Marketplace push for Acme Cloud Partners:
> 
> 1) Manifest/service-principal secrets rotation — we're planning a controlled rotation of the publishing service principal (key rotation + manifest update) and would like to coordinate the exact cutover window so it doesn't conflict with your listing tasks.

We can support either approach (rotate existing SP or provision a new SP) but recommend provisioning a new SP when possible — it gives a rollback path and avoids immediate expiry issues if something in the pipeline expects the existing credentials. If you do rotate the existing SP, please provide detailed rollback steps.

Regarding evidence: we'll need a publisher-id proof (PDF with org verification) and a signed contact confirmation. DocuSign is fine for the contact confirmation; our partner ops team will provide a link once you confirm you want us to issue it.

Blackout windows: No hard blackout for the dates you suggested, but the validation queue is heavier early in the week. If you can get artifacts to us by EOD 6/18 we can aim for the 6/24 slot.

I'll loop Joel here for infrastructure timing.

—Samir
Samir Patel | Partnerships Manager
Cloud Partnerships, Inc.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-17T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Manifest secrets rotation & marketplace deploy timing — internal plan

Kimberly / Vivek — forwarding Samir's response and outlining next steps from our side so we can move fast: 

On Tue, Jun 16, 2026 at 11:30 AM, Samir Patel <samir@cloudpartner.co> wrote:
> We can support either approach (rotate existing SP or provision a new SP) but recommend provisioning a new SP when possible — it gives a rollback path and avoids immediate expiry issues if something in the pipeline expects the existing credentials.

Proposed internal plan: 
- Marissa: produce publisher-id proof (publisher-id-evidence.pdf) and a short org verification PDF (security-proof.pdf) by EOD 6/18. I'll coordinate with Legal for the signed contact confirmation (DocuSign).
- Vivek: prepare infra playbook for new SP creation + rollback notes; test in staging on 6/20. Vivek, can you confirm the staging test window and whether the deployment automation will pick up the new SP without additional manifest changes?
- Kimberly: confirm final listing slot with Microsoft once we have artifacts.

Acceptance criteria for 6/24 slot: publisher-id evidence uploaded, DocuSign signed contact, staging test pass for SP rotation. If any of these fail we'll request the next available slot (likely week of 6/29).

Vivek — assign the infra ticket to me after staging confirmation and I'll track the DocuSign.

Thanks,
Marissa
Director, Marketplace Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: publisher-id-evidence.pdf (to be generated), security-proof.pdf (to be generated)
From: Azure Marketplace Support <azure-marketplace-support@microsoft.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@cloudpartner.co>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Cc: Joel Tan <joel@acmecloud.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-17T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Manifest secrets rotation & marketplace deploy timing

Hi Kimberly / Samir — 

Thanks for the timeline and the manifest diff. We can accommodate a maintenance window for SP rotation provided the following are submitted ahead of the scheduled slot: 

Required artifacts (submit by 2026-06-18 EOD to keep 6/24 slot):
- Publisher ID evidence (scanned org verification) — publisher-id-evidence.pdf
- Security posture summary (short PDF) — security-proof.pdf
- Updated manifest with new service principal ID (if provisioning new SP) or manifest diff showing rotation date/time — manifest.json.diff
- Contact confirmation (DocuSign) for the person listed in the publisher record

Operational notes: 
- If you choose to provision a new SP, include both the old and new SP IDs in the manifest so our validation hooks can confirm mapping.
- We have a limited listing deployment window on 2026-06-24 from 03:00-06:00 UTC; slot will be held if artifacts arrive by EOD 6/18. If artifacts are late we'll offer the next window 2026-06-30.

I've attached a sample security proof template (security-proof.pdf) and a short checklist (publisher-id-evidence.pdf) to this message for your legal team. Please let us know when DocuSign is ready and we'll issue the listing reservation token.

Regards,
Azure Marketplace Partner Ops
Microsoft Corporation

Attachments: security-proof.pdf (template), publisher-id-evidence.pdf (checklist)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@cloudpartner.co>, Azure Marketplace Support <azure-marketplace-support@microsoft.com>, Joel Tan <joel@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-18T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Manifest secrets rotation & marketplace deploy timing — confirmation

Thanks everyone — quick confirmation and assignments: 

- Marissa: please upload publisher-id-evidence.pdf and security-proof.pdf to the portal by EOD today (6/18). Marissa confirmed she'll handle DocuSign routing to exec contacts.
- Vivek: test SP provisioning and rollback in staging on 6/20 and post the ticket number in this thread. If staging looks green, please include both SP IDs in the manifest and send the manifest diff back to Samir + Azure.
- Samir / Azure: please hold the 6/24 03:00-06:00 UTC deploy slot pending artifacts. If anything changes we'll fallback to 6/30.

Once Marissa confirms uploads and Vivek confirms staging pass I'll sign the DocuSign and reply-all to trigger the reservation token.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
